authority_precedence: If this measurement contract conflicts with the canonical parent trading rule, the parent rule wins and Diamond adjudication is BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH.

sample_rule.rationale: Reuses the 25-resolved-trade prospective floor frozen on 2026-09-16 before any post-freeze event/outcome. It is not a post-outcome sample-size choice.

parent_economic_rule_unchanged.entry: first fully available 15-minute BNBBTC bar open strictly greater than canonical signal timestamp

causal_measurement.purpose: Measure the preregistered BNB-specific demand-shock fingerprint without changing event eligibility or the parent trade.
causal_measurement.market_data: public read-only Binance Spot 1m klines only
causal_measurement.event_window_alignment: first complete 1m bar whose open_time is strictly greater than canonical signal timestamp
causal_measurement.return_definition: simple return from first aligned 1m open to close of the final complete 1m bar in the window

baseline.definition: median quote_asset_volume across the most recent 20 prior UTC dates with a complete same-clock 60m window

statistical_note: 17/25 positive signs has one-sided exact Binomial(25,0.5) tail probability approximately 0.0539. This is a preregistered descriptive robustness hurdle, not a standalone proof of causality.
anti_rescue: no regime filter added after outcomes
no live-order inference from this contract
